title: In a Dark, Dark Wood
author: Ruth Ware
summary: Reclusive writer Nora is invited to a hen weekend at a glass house deep in the English woods, hosted by a friend she has not seen in ten years. By the end of the weekend someone is hurt and Nora cannot remember why.
readIf: you want a quick, atmospheric whodunit with a cut-off setting and a cast who all have something to hide.
skipIf: you prefer a patient detective to a nervous, unreliable witness.

pairings.reason: The model for a group trapped together as secrets surface, in an older and tidier form.
A wedding-weekend variation with another isolated setting and a pile of old grievances.
Friends snowed in at a remote lodge, with a murder and a slowly shifting cast of suspects.
